verdict.rationale: Termius's Keychain lets developers store credentials once and reference them across multiple Hosts/Groups without duplication, with automatic propagation of password changes to all referencing hosts, all backed by an encrypted vault (Personal/Team). This is well documented first-party, though there's no independent hands-on confirmation of the reference/update mechanism specifically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the vault-reference behavior beyond vendor docs.
